external.note: relative 0.5 %; absolute floors cover the rounding of CAEPIPE's printed values

tolerances.basis_note: ASSUMPTION: pilot tolerance chosen by the implementer for the proof of concept; the governed external-oracle tolerance class is TBD (owner ruling); never loosened to match CAEPIPE

declared_differences.description: Shear deformation: SWBPIPE's frame preview is Euler-Bernoulli; a Timoshenko formulation adds shear flexibility. Predicted difference = Timoshenko - Euler-Bernoulli hand value with kappa = 0.5 (ASSUMPTION: CAEPIPE's shear formulation is not documented in the admitted sources).
CAEPIPE applies its own gravitational constant to the weight density the MBF writer derives with standard gravity 9.80665 m/s2; no prediction (the reactions must still meet the external tolerance).
